title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity + v1.22.0
author: Priya Shah
release_notes:
Unified SDK behavior for auth token refresh, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming client ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Bumps SDK versions to v1.22.0. No API surface-breaking changes for existing consumers.
- Fixes streaming reconnect edge cases
- Harmonizes default retry policy to exponential backoff with jitter
- Adds explicit token-refresh hook and improved error messaging
description:
Motivation: parity inconsistencies across SDKs have caused confusion (different retry defaults, slightly different streaming callback ergonomics, and varying auth refresh hooks). This PR unifies auth token refresh APIs, standardizes retry/backoff defaults, and improves streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go SDKs.

Summary of changes: implemented a common retry policy (exp backoff w/ jitter) and central auth refresh hook, refactored streaming client init to a consistent callback/async iterator pattern, and bumped package versions to v1.22.0.

Checklist:
- [x] Python: unified AuthProvider interface + retry wrapper
- [x] TypeScript: streaming iterator + auth refresh hook
- [x] Go: exported TokenSource adapter + retry middleware
- [x] Integration tests for streaming parity
- [x] Updated CHANGELOGs and migration notes

Compatibility notes: default behaviors are compatible for most users; users who relied on previous timeout/retry defaults may observe fewer immediate retries (safer exponential backoff). Migration notes included in each SDK CHANGELOG.

Testing: unit tests updated for all SDKs; added cross-SDK streaming parity integration test (runs in CI matrix). CI initially failed on TS lint, fixed in follow-up commit.
